caveats: Surface temperature is not felt or air temperature.
No dated planting record is not proof of no planting.
Post-window plantings in treated cells can contribute to later contrasts.
Cross-sensor sensitivity is not independent confirmation.
Some static matching features may postdate planting; source-year columns must be considered before causal interpretation.
Dated inventory begins in 2015; earlier cohorts can mature unseen in both groups.
The 2008-2011 same-sensor pre-cohort fake-date check found a nonzero contrast.
Matching on noisy pre-outcomes can select regression to the mean.

pre_trend_diagnostics.limitations: Descriptive only; matching uses these same pre-period data, so this is not an independent parallel-trends test.

all.pooled_iid_se_warning: Across-site SEs assume independence; use source-block sensitivity and its limitations.
all.pre_period_mean_warning: Pre-period centering makes the pooled pre mean approximately zero by construction; this is not a parallel-trends test.

pooled_block_sensitivity.limitations: Conditional on fixed matches and observed scenes. Deletes treated and control trajectories jointly; preserves reused-control dependence within each deletion. Spatial blocks at 2 km and 5 km with two origins are sensitivity choices, not validated independence boundaries. Intervals are normal approximations, not causal confidence intervals.

specification_comparison.interpretation: Specification sensitivity, not a correction or a separately identified causal estimate.

year_block_sensitivity.limitations: Common-cohort normal-approximation sensitivity; few years and unmodelled dependence remain.

combined_space_year_sensitivity.limitations: Adds SEs rather than selecting the wider component. This permits positive covariance in an additive-component interpretation, but is not a calibrated multiway variance estimator. Components can overlap; source-block dependence and observational bias remain.

pre_cohort_fake_date.limitations: Thin older-sensor window, one post year. Tests a period before the recorded cohort, not a treeless city. A nonzero contrast challenges causal attribution but does not measure headline bias.

source_block_sensitivity.limitations: Conditional on fixed matches and observed scenes. Deletes treated and control trajectories jointly; preserves reused-control dependence within each deletion. Spatial blocks at 2 km and 5 km with two origins are sensitivity choices, not validated independence boundaries. Intervals are normal approximations, not causal confidence intervals.

sensor_family_support.interpretation: Cross-sensor sensitivity is not independent confirmation; scene differencing does not remove family-specific spatial contrast changes.

later_planting_context.interpretation: Post-period differences can include later plantings; dose_trees only counts the treatment window.

pre_trend_diagnostics.limitations: Descriptive only; matching uses these same pre-period data, so this is not an independent parallel-trends test.
